name: call-mode
description: Screen-sharing guard: while a client watches your screen, Claude keeps prices, hours and other internal matters out of the chat.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/dist/hook.js"
